community_list_entries.name: DolphinBench: Mapping the Pareto Frontier of Agent Memory

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark evaluating memory via agent task completion: three knowledge-work personas each with ~500k tokens of multi-year, session-organized user messages and 200 tasks verified to need history (decisions, preferences, project developments); reports cost and latency. Dataset and code at dolphinbench
